column1: # `now` reads the current instant from the registry's Clock capability.
# Production uses a wall clock; this spec suite installs a FixedClock
# frozen at 2021-01-01T00:00:00Z, so `now` is deterministic here. The
# boru:time-util module's time-now* family reads the same capability.

column3: now reads the (frozen, in specs) clock capability
